claims.statement: The FastAPI application composes dashboard, plan, workflow approval, Linear, Slack, health/completion, and GitHub routers; it refuses wildcard dashboard CORS origins when credentials are enabled and validates sandbox and local-development model configuration during lifespan startup.
GitHub, Linear, and Slack webhook routes verify their platform signature against the raw request body before JSON parsing and return HTTP 401 when verification fails.
Slack message delivery is deduplicated by claim_slack_event before the normal background task is scheduled, so only a claimed event can create a Slack run.
Slack blocks operations in externally shared or unverified channels; an app mention in an external shared channel receives a claimed one-time refusal reply and is not dispatched.
Slack resolves a location by preferring an explicit mapping, then metadata matches, then a deterministic id; a conflicting explicit mapping is surfaced as an error rather than guessed.
Slack sends explicit requests with multitask_strategy='interrupt' and other follow-ups with 'enqueue'; message edits are queued rather than dispatched as standalone runs.

GitHub routes multiplex issue, PR, comment, review, push, and CI events, filter unsupported actions, apply repository/organization gates, require mentions for ordinary issue/comment work, and route review-finding replies separately.

GitHub PR comment processing recovers an embedded Open SWE branch UUID when present and otherwise derives a PR thread id, resolves the user's token with one 401 refresh retry, reacts with eyes, serializes comments since the last tag, and dispatches them.
Reviewer runs use reviewer_thread_id and assistant_id='reviewer', separating auto-review and re-review work from the coding-agent thread and graph.
Desktop execution is enabled only for source='desktop' runs whose local project path resolves to an allowlisted project or a worktree under the configured worktrees directory.
Thread-id derivations are a persisted cross-process routing contract, so changing their namespaces or input strings can orphan live threads.
dispatch_agent_run rejects mixing a prebuilt input with raw content or identities, otherwise constructs input as needed and delegates all agent/reviewer triggers to create_durable_run.
A completion webhook is attached only when its secret is configured and its URL is absolute and non-loopback; the receiving health route fails closed on the token.

Outside code channels, Slack admits ordinary messages only when they are a direct mention, DM, allowed-bot message, kitchen-channel message, or admitted solo-thread follow-up; code-channel conversation is always directed to the shared channel session.
Slack worker dispatch requires a valid mapped GitHub user token for a human sender; an unlinked or revoked token posts an account-link or re-authentication prompt instead of starting a run.

Linear only admits non-bot Comment create events mentioning Open SWE, resolves the repository from explicit comment text then the author's dashboard default then workspace default, and rejects an unavailable or non-allowlisted repository.

The Linear worker derives a deterministic issue thread, maps the triggering author's email to GitHub identity, persists Linear source context and metadata, and dispatches typed system issue and human comment messages.

The dashboard proxy permits lazy creation only for run.start; it authorizes commands from thread metadata, enriches human starts with credential, model, image, identity, participant, and invocation data, and resolves busy threads by steering or attributed enqueueing while machine principals receive a conflict.

Scheduled launches recheck workspace existence and repository access, create a fresh system-owned automation thread, optionally require a Slack root message before launch, and create their agent run through create_durable_run.

GitHub issue-opened automations claim each delivery and schedule pair to suppress duplicates, restrict outsider-triggered public-repository work to the event repository, and release a claim when launch fails.

Input serialization enforces human/system kind alignment, XML-escapes authored content in input-message envelopes, and deduplicates SHA-256-hashed dynamic context introductions while allowing summarized-away context to be reintroduced.

create_durable_run defaults to interrupt multitasking, sync durability, creation on absent threads, resumable standard-mode and subgraph streaming, and it correlates invocation id and start time across configurable state and metadata.

Completion finalizes terminal telemetry and transcript state, delivers queued subscriptions for success/error/timeout, starts pending follow-ups after eligible success, and handles successful Slack cost refreshes or idempotent source-specific failure replies; interrupted runs do not receive failure replies.
